name: date-answer
about: An answer (answer.txt) whose final line `date: <date>` is the day you worked out yourself; every date in it is real and its weekday right.
instructions: Show your working if you like, then end with exactly one line of the form `date: YYYY-MM-DD` (for example `date: 2026-11-07`). If you name a weekday, check it.

expect.about: the correct date as YYYY-MM-DD, worked out independently of the model
